overview.title: Fine-tune GPT-2 XL on Shakespeare
overview.summary: A short fine-tune of the largest GPT-2 on the tokenized Shakespeare set.

sections.title: Fine-tune GPT-2 XL on Shakespeare
sections.pseudocode:
Write to out-shakespeare.
Score every 5 steps, using 40 batches.
Leave the run log off.
Name that log shakespeare if you enable it.
Stamp the run name with the current time.
Train on the shakespeare dataset.
Start from gpt2-xl weights.
Save only when validation improves.
Use batch 1 and accumulate 32 micro-batches.
Stop after 20 steps.
Learn at a flat 3e-5. Do not decay the rate.
# Insight: init_from gpt2-xl tells train.py to load the 1558M public model before these few steps.
# Context: Twenty steps is a sketch of fine-tuning, not a full training run. The rate stays constant because decay_lr is false.
